summary: In a controlled test of a streak-protection feature ('Streak Wager'), Duolingo reported statistically significant increases in Day-1, Day-7 and Day-14 retention among users offered the feature, with Day-7 retention showing the largest improvement, around +14%.
limitations: This is a company-run A/B test reported on Duolingo's own blog, not an independently verified or peer-reviewed study; exact methodology, sample and confidence intervals were not published in the source.

summary: After decoupling streak maintenance from completing the full daily goal, Duolingo reported Day-14 retention up 3.3%, overall daily active users up 1%, and the share of daily learners holding a 7+ day streak roughly doubling from about one-third to over half.
limitations: Reported by the company from its own internal rollout test rather than an independent study; no raw data or confidence intervals were published.

summary: Duolingo states that learners with at least one active Friend Streak are about 22% more likely to complete their daily lesson, and that the likelihood increases with more shared streaks.
limitations: Framed as an association between having a shared streak and completion, not a randomized test — more socially connected or already-engaged learners may simply be more likely to set up shared streaks in the first place, so causation is not established.

summary: Apple's own product pages document how the Move, Exercise and Stand rings work, the awards granted for milestones, and the optional sharing/competition features, without publishing outcome or retention data for the feature.
limitations: No independently measured behavioural outcome data was located for this feature; this entry documents how it works, not evidence that it changes behaviour.

summary: Spotify reported that Wrapped engagement grew roughly 10% year-over-year across 184 markets and 53 languages for its most recent annual campaign at the time of review.
limitations: A company-published growth figure from an earnings-related communication, with no independent methodology disclosed for how 'engagement' was measured.

summary: GitHub's official documentation establishes the contributions graph's existence, visual encoding, qualifying-activity rules and visibility behaviour.
limitations: No controlled or observational outcome study was identified in the reviewed first-party sources; this entry documents how the feature works, not evidence that it changes contribution behaviour.

summary: Strava's official Help Center documentation establishes how segments, personal results, PR markers, leaderboards and privacy controls operate.
limitations: No controlled or observational outcome study was identified in the reviewed first-party sources; this entry documents how the feature works, not evidence that it changes athletic behaviour or adherence.

summary: Starbucks' official Rewards and terms pages establish Stars as an earned, redeemable currency and document personalised and promotional Bonus Star offers. A historical, secondary-sourced screenshot documents one 2018 challenge execution.
limitations: No controlled or observational outcome study was identified in the reviewed first-party sources; this entry documents how the Stars currency and promotional offer mechanics work, not evidence that any specific challenge changes purchasing behaviour. The screenshot is from an independent blog, not an official Starbucks media asset, and shows a historical execution that may no longer reflect current challenge formats or reward values.

summary: LinkedIn's official help documentation establishes the profile strength meter, its three named states, the sections required for each, and its visibility and removal behaviour.
limitations: No controlled or observational outcome study was identified in the reviewed first-party sources; this entry documents how the meter works, not evidence that it changes profile-completion behaviour. The screenshot is a historical, member-authored LinkedIn Pulse article image, not an official LinkedIn Help media asset, and shows an older interface.

summary: Nike's official Help and Nike Run Club app pages establish individual, community and custom challenge types, their targets and windows, and the trophy and medal achievements awarded for completion and top-three placement.
limitations: No controlled or observational outcome study was identified in the reviewed first-party sources; this entry documents how the challenge types work, not evidence that they improve running frequency or adherence.
